Note: Growth percentages rounded to the nearest integer; Metrics exclude Bullion and Digi-gold sales; 
* - International Business includes metrics of Damas Jewellery (67% holding) that was consolidated in Titan effective Jan’ 26 
 
Domestic: 
• Jewellery – Portfolio (all brands) clocked c.21% YoY growth for the quarter. Consumer demand 
was healthy for most of the quarterly period, with some softening towards the close owing to 
shift in the festive calendar to Q3FY27. Aided by 'Festival of Diamonds’ and brand-level 
promotions, studded jewellery grew strongly in the early thirties while plain gold jewellery grew 
c.20% YoY. The investment-led coins demand tapered (off a high base), resulting in high single-
digit decline YoY. Buyer growth (at a portfolio level) came in mid-single digits with average ticket 
sizes seeing double-digit growth in this period. 
• Watches – Business recorded a robust c.30% YoY growth for the quarter. Continuing to ride on 
strong premiumization trends, Analog watches clocked healthy growth in the early thirties. Smart 
Watches business saw a recovery with encouraging high single digit growth for the quarter. 
• EyeCare – Division delivered a strong performance with growth of c.28% YoY, driven by focused 
execution across key strategic priorities. The multi-brand approach, continuous upgradation of 
the (existing) store network and a sharper merchandise portfolio is meaningfully enhancing the 
overall customer experience, yielding encouraging results for the business. 
• Emerging Businesses – In the portfolio, Fragrances clocked mid-thirties growth YoY, Women’s 
Bags grew (YoY) in the twenties, and Taneira’s growth was in high single digits YoY. 
International: The Jewellery businesses of Tanishq, Mia and CaratLane (combined) continued its strong 
double-digit momentum in North America. The GCC business has held up well in a volatile geopolitical 
environment and recording improving growths for Tanishq, with Damas showing early signs of recovery. 
The above information for the period ended 30th Sep’26 is provisional and subject to Limited Review by Statutory Auditors of the Company. 
For Titan Company Limited, 
 
 
 
Ashok Sonthalia 
Chief Financial Officer 
Titan Company’s Consumer Businesses registered a growth of c.25% YoY in Q2FY27. A total of 78 stores (net) 
were added during the quarter expanding the combined retail network presence to 3,758 stores.
